The '''1958–59 Serie A''' season was the 29th edition of [[Serie A]], the top-level [[association football|football]] competition in [[Italy]]. The championship was won by [[A.C. Milan|Milan]].

==Teams==
[[Triestina]] and [[AS Bari|Bari]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
